options.text: Planet P must be hotter than planet Q, whatever their atmospheres are like.
With similar atmospheres, planet P is generally hotter; a stronger heat-trapping atmosphere on Q could change that ranking.
With similar atmospheres, the farther planet Q is generally hotter than P.
Because planet Q looks red and planet P looks blue, Q must be hotter.

stem:
Mohit compares two planets. Planet P is nearer the Sun than planet Q. Their atmospheres can trap heat differently. Planet Q looks red and planet P looks blue.

Which statement is the best guide?

teacher.key_rationale: Nearer planets are generally warmer when atmospheres are similar, but a strong heat-trapping atmosphere can change the ranking.
